test_case_name: Login as guest on the account comparison page with 'Mantieni L'accesso' checked

intents.intent: Type $email into the 'E-mail' input
Type $password into the 'Password' input
Click the 'Mantieni L'accesso' checkbox to enable session persistence
Click the 'ENTRA' button to log in as guest
And then check that the guest user is logged in and session persistence is enabled

test_case_name: Login as guest on the account comparison page without 'Mantieni L'accesso' checked

intents.intent: Type $email into the 'E-mail' input
Type $password into the 'Password' input
Click the 'ENTRA' button to log in as guest
And then check that the guest user is logged in
